description: Decode a raw serialized EVM transaction before it is broadcast: type, chain, recovered sender, recipient, value, nonce, gas and fee caps, max cost, calldata selector, access and EIP-7702 authorization lists, and the hash it will have. Spot what a wallet is really being asked to sign. Costs $0.002 USDC per call (x402).
